Conservation Area Forest
Surface
Conservation Area Forest, Surface
The sun is bright today, and a faint sliver of light manages to bleed through your thick blindfold. Without your sight, you cannot help but imagine how lush the forest must be.
Wind rustles the branches, brushing past you before joining the distant birdsong. With your other senses heightened, you feel even more relaxed during this leisurely stroll.
Then, all the sounds fade away at once as a familiar voice calls out to you from just ahead. In a world without sight, <phonetic=her>its</phonetic> presence is the only thing that remains.
Lucia
Commandant, how are you holding up? Do you need me to adjust anything?
Lucia holds your hand without moving, standing still with you for just a moment.

After a mission, you and Lucia joined a treasure hunt held at a conservation area, in which teams of two must work together to reach the end. However, one would be blindfolded, while the other must guide with words.
It has not gone smoothly so far. Although you are past the halfway point, the right path forward keeps eluding you, and you can sense Lucia's worry clearly even if you cannot see her.
Can you hold my hand a little tighter?
Can you tell me a bit more about what's around us?
Lucia catches the faint unease beneath your words. Assuming it is due to you being blindfolded, she does as asked without hesitation.
She steps closer to you, weaving your fingers together until her grip is firm and sure. The sense of touch makes up for the loss of your sight.
Lucia
Do you need more information to go on? We're at a crossroads, and there's no marker in sight.
Lucia
That said, going by the current positions of the sun and the shadows... The path straight ahead should be our best bet.
How are you feeling, Lucia?
I want to hear more about your own thoughts.
Lucia
My own... thoughts?
Just those few words are enough to calm her. She begins to look at your surroundings with a different perspective.
Lucia
I was indeed a little distracted because I was having trouble finding the route, but holding your hand and talking with you like this has calmed me down a lot.
Lucia
The sunlight through the trees is lovely and warm. You must feel it too, Commandant, don't you? The forest is lush here, and there's been so much life along the way.
Lucia
There's something calming about this place. But more importantly... you're here with me.
She focuses on the warmth pressed against her palm, and whatever troubled her quietly fades.
Then let's focus on that instead. The treasure hunt can wait.
Just do this whenever you need to unwind.
As long as I can help you this way.
It takes Lucia a moment to understand your actions: holding her hand, you realized how anxious she was being, so you stepped in and tried to relax her.
Lucia
...I know what you're trying to do, Commandant. I just wish we could succeed.
Lucia

The organizer mentioned how this whole game was inspired by some theory of emotional healing. He was even certain that whoever wins would find a treasure that brings happiness to the victors and their companions.
Lucia
I still don't know what this treasure actually is, but I want to find it.
Lucia
But now... You're blindfolded, and you can't even see the view before you.
But I still have you with me.
You're my eyes, Lucia. My world is whatever you see.
So keep talking. Tell me what our world looks like.

Still unable to see, you find another way to experience the world through Lucia. The warmth of the sun takes the shape of her smile, and the brush of the wind carries the weight and gentleness of her words.
As Lucia paints the world in her own words, every scene she conjures becomes as glistening as her. Together, it becomes something you can only call happiness.
Lucia
Right now, I can see two birds perched on a branch nearby. They're nestled side by side intimately.
Lucia
The flowers here are beautiful. They've drawn quite a few butterflies, and one of them isn't shy at all. It's been circling around us for a while now, and...
Lucia
...Pfft! Commandant, it just landed on your shoulder.

Her laughter and her footsteps draw closer, and you can tell she must have stepped up in front of you to reach for the butterfly on your shoulder. Because of your blindfold, she can do so without hesitation.
Snap. Something feels wrong with your blindfold all of a sudden, and it falls away on its own before you can react. The knot holding it together has seemingly come loose for no particular reason.

Lucia
Eh...? Commandant...
The sudden brightness stings at first, but the world comes back into focus after a few blinks. The blur fades, and you find Lucia's face before you, her eyes meeting yours.

Lucia clearly has not anticipated it either, and the surprise is written plainly across her face. The sunlight she has spent so long describing now rests on her features, caught in her gaze like scattered stars.
Every beautiful thing around you fades into the background. In this moment, the brightest thing in your eyes is her.
I think I've already found the treasure.
She's right here, standing in front of me.
Lucia pauses for a moment before smiling. She can accept this feeling now, and she feels the same in this moment.
In Lucia's eyes, that same warm sunlight falls on her own treasure, and she finds herself unable to look away.
Lucia
You're right, Commandant. Perhaps I never needed to go look for something else. Everything I've ever wanted and longed for has always been right here beside me.
Lucia
The prize of this game might turn out to be something wonderful... but compared to something ethereal like that...
Lucia
Getting to hold your hand, being here with you, sharing this quiet moment together... No prize in the world can compare.
Bird
Tweet! Tweet!

The chirping catches both of your attention. One of the birds has left its perch and fluttered down to the ground, pecking curiously at the blindfold. Picking it up, Lucia finds a small note tucked inside.
"Now, turn and look at the companion beside you. Congratulations! You've found the most precious treasure in this game."
"Now, turn and look at the companion beside you. Congratulations! You've found the most precious treasure in this game."
Lucia
The strap was designed to give way on its own. Wear it long enough, and friction will do the job, dropping it and revealing the note hidden inside...
It seems we were on the "right" path all along.
A happy accident, all things considered.
Lucia glances toward a clearing not far off with a shallow pond. She has passed through it with you once before, but you two never got to take it in properly.
Lucia
It doesn't matter if we arrived early or late. What matters is that neither of us missed it... the chance to become each other's "treasure."
Lucia
There's still so much more of this forest to see. And if "happiness" means being together... then there are plenty more surprises waiting for us out there.
Lucia
So... let's go, Commandant. Give me your hand.
Lucia
Let's go see more beautiful views together.
